Whoooo! I made it before the month ended! All thanks to working really hard, I managed to finish making the story in time. This story is based on the winner of the "Theme voting" that I've started doing in order to make stories that I can enjoy making, and I have to confess, I really liked doing this story! Anyways, I will give a bit of a synopsis of "Blending Infiltration":

In a world where superheroes are the ones dealing with villains, one day an invisible villain appeared that no one knew how she or he looked like, that villain is "Master Control". Ever since that new villain appeared, the mind drones did too. These female-looking people all covered in latex and having big fake latex lips are attacking people, pinning them down and having sex with them to render them unconscious and then turning them into more mind drones! Only one person will be able to infiltrate and try to defeat Master Control, and that is Archer! Is she going to make it?
